text.lead: The Big Hit (French: Un triomphe) is a 2020 French comedy-drama film directed by Emmanuel Courcol. It is a free adaptation of the experiences of Jan Jönson when he staged a theatre performance with prison inmates.
text.cast:
- Kad Merad - Etienne Carboni
- David Ayala - Patrick Le Querrec
- Lamine Cissokho - Alex
- Sofian Khammes - Kamel Ramdane
- Pierre Lottin - Jordan Fortineau
text.reception: The Big Hit has an approval rating of 64% on review aggregator website Rotten Tomatoes, based on 14 reviews, and an average rating of 5.5/10.
